name: Voice of Victory
oracle_text:
Mobilize 2 (Whenever this creature attacks, create two tapped and attacking 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.)
Your opponents can't cast spells during your turn.
blocked_sentences: Your opponents can't cast spells during your turn.

needs.what: A player-wide static that **withholds cast actions** from a set of players while it is on the battlefield -- a `cant_cast_spells` entry in `STATIC_EFFECTS` / `PLAYER_WIDE_STATIC_EFFECTS`, carrying `affects_player` (here `"opponent"`) plus the usual optional static `condition` (here `{"is_your_turn": true}`, which `static_condition_keys` already spells), and consulted by `legality._priority_actions` in the same place and the same way `split_second_active` is: when the prohibition is live for `pid`, `_cast_actions` is not extended, so the seat is offered only its mana abilities, land drop and other special actions. Ideally the static also takes an optional filter over the spells it stops, because the whole family is printed that way -- Grand Abolisher ("During your turn, your opponents can't cast spells and can't activate abilities of artifacts, creatures, and enchantments they control"), Drannith Magistrate ("Your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands"), Teferi, Time Raveler, Deafening Silence ("Each player can't cast more than one noncreature spell each turn"). Voice of Victory itself needs only the unfiltered form scoped to opponents on your turn. Nothing else on this card is blocked -- the Mobilize 2 half is fully expressible today (see `notes`), so no partial answer was written.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine has exactly one cast prohibition and it is the wrong shape in all three dimensions. `split_second` (a `card_level_rider_key`, not a static) is read by `legality.split_second_active`, which walks the *stack* looking for a spell whose CardDef sets the flag; it therefore lasts only while that spell is on the stack, applies to **every** player including its own controller, and cannot be scoped to a turn or to a permanent sitting on the battlefield. `epic` is the other casting prohibition and it is the opposite card: it stops *you* casting spells for the rest of the game, is again a card-level rider on the spell that resolved, and has no seat or duration vocabulary. Nothing in `static_effects` reaches casting at all: the closest entries are permissions and prices, not prohibitions -- `cast_from_graveyard`, `cast_from_library_top` and `play_lands_from_library_top` widen where a spell may be cast from, `spell_cost_reduction` and `attack_tax` change what it costs, `spells_cant_be_countered` protects a spell that has already been cast, and `freeze_opponent_lands` is the only opponent-facing lock in the list but it stops lands untapping, which taxes mana rather than forbidding the cast (an opponent with Treasures, rituals or untapped lands from elsewhere casts freely, and one with no mana is stopped by a card that prints nothing about mana). The `cant_*` family in `ops` and `static_effects` -- `cant_attack`, `cant_attack_you`, `cant_block`, `cant_sacrifice`, `cant_attack_player` -- are all combat and sacrifice restrictions on *permanents*; none is a player-wide casting restriction, and `PLAYER_WIDE_STATIC_EFFECTS` (the 13 statics that take `affects_player`) contains no casting entry. `lock_abilities` is an op that silences a chosen permanent's activated abilities and says nothing about spells. Writing the line any other way would be an approximation of a hard lock: a `spell_cast` trigger that counters the spell is not "can't cast" (the opponent still casts it, still pays for it, still fires cast triggers, and a spell with `uncounterable` or a protected controller gets through anyway), and a cost tax is not a prohibition.

notes:
Only the second printed line is blocked; the Mobilize 2 line is fully expressible with today's vocabulary and can be pasted in unchanged once the static lands. The printed token, "1/1 red Warrior creature token", is `warrior_1_1_r`, which is already in `token_ids` -- this is NOT a token-definitions gap. The card, complete but for the missing static, is:

{
  "id": "voice_of_victory",
  "name": "Voice of Victory",
  "oracle_text": "Mobilize 2 (Whenever this creature attacks, create two tapped and attacking 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.)\nYour opponents can't cast spells during your turn.",
  "mana_cost": "{1}{W}",
  "types": ["Creature"],
  "subtypes": ["Human", "Bard"],
  "power": 1,
  "toughness": 3,
  "colors": ["W"],
  "color_identity": ["W"],
  "abilities": [
    {
      "kind": "triggered",
      "text": "Mobilize 2.",
      "trigger": {"event": "attacks", "source": "self", "controller": "you"},
      "effects": [
        {"op": "create_token", "token": "warrior_1_1_r", "amount": {"const": 2}, "tapped": true, "attacking": true, "as": "mobilized"},
        {"op": "delay", "step": "end_step", "text": "Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.", "effects": [{"op": "sacrifice", "objects": {"binding": "mobilized"}}]}
      ]
    },
    { "<the blocked static goes here>": "kind: static, text: 'Your opponents can't cast spells during your turn.', effect: cant_cast_spells, affects_player: 'opponent', condition: {\"is_your_turn\": true}" }
  ]
}

Expectation once unblocked: the interesting text is an attack trigger and a static, and the harness declines combat, so nothing observable happens on cast -- assert {"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}.

One incidental observation for whoever closes this, offered as data rather than a request: the shipped Zurgo Stormrender (data/cards/zurgo.cards.json) writes Mobilize 1 as a bare `create_token` with `tapped`/`attacking` and no delayed sacrifice, so its tokens are never sacrificed at the next end step. The `create_token` `as` + `delay`/`sacrifice` shape above is the full line and is already used in the pool for the same job (a `copy_permanent` with `as: "the_token"` followed by `delay` + `exile` over `{"binding": "the_token"}` in data/cards/auto/templates.cards.json).
